desc:
Welcome to Edgeworks! a VR exclusive game about physics puzzles, freerunning, parkour and climbing!

If you have Criticism/critique, or issues with the game PLEASE get in touch.

Known headsets compatibility issues:
Oculus: None. this game was developed and designed around Oculus Headsets.

Vive, WMR, Valve Index: Jumping can be done by clicking the right thumbstick. (or middle of the trackpad)
mag dropping can only be done by tapping the current mag with a fresh one.

these issues are caused by the roblox engine, and are not likely to be fixed until roblox themselves fix it. (which is not likely)

Creative Attributes: 
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/edgeworks-creative-attributes/957041

I feel like I shouldn't have to say this, but this game REQUIRES a VR headset.
